title: Aftermath
publicSourceReferences: Plaid Hat Games Official Adventure Book & Rulebook

milestones.title: Foundations of the Colony
milestones.description: Establish the rodent sanctuary, gather vital scrap and grains, and fortify the colony against wandering predators.

milestones.title: The Ironfang Syndicate
milestones.description: Repel the hostile rat gang raiding party, secure perimeter outposts, and forge treaties with neighbouring critters.

milestones.title: The Human Vaults
milestones.description: Infiltrate the overgrown human laboratory, decipher strange technological artifacts, and uncover clues about the Calamity.

milestones.title: The Predator King's Siege
milestones.phase: Act 2 Finale - Defense of the Sanctuary
milestones.description: Unite the diverse animal factions to withstand a catastrophic predator assault and safeguard the colony's future.

milestones.title: Dawn of the New World
milestones.description: Complete all character personal quests, unlock every colony upgrade, and establish a thriving animal civilization.
